title: SMDR2 DRC Handoff Manifest
description: Top-level manifest accompanying every DRC handoff bundle. The bundle is a directory (or zip) containing this file at its root plus the DXF + Match JSON files referenced by every entry in `files`. The downstream rule-checking team consumes this manifest to group files by role and run their own DRC.

bundle_version.description: Semantic version of the manifest contract. Consumers MUST refuse manifests whose major version they do not understand.

product_id.description: SMDR2 internal product identifier. Opaque to the consumer; useful for cross-referencing reports.

product_name.description: Optional human-readable product name. Purely informational.

version_id.description: SMDR2 internal version identifier — the snapshot whose bindings and Match JSONs this bundle was built from. Rules are product-level and version-independent; this field tells the consumer which snapshot was checked.

version_label.description: Human-entered version label, unique within the product (e.g. "v1", "A", "2026-06").

exported_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC, second precision or finer) of when the bundle was generated.

check_dam.description: Whether the operator enabled the DAM (encapsulation dam) check for this version. The downstream rule-checker SHOULD run its DAM rules only when true. Absent is equivalent to false (pre-2.1.0 bundles).

files.description: Every DXF + Match JSON pair in the bundle, one entry per file. Order is significant only as a stable tie-breaker — consumers SHOULD group by `role` rather than rely on positional ordering.

role.description: Functional role this DXF plays in the product. A role MAY appear in multiple entries (multi-DXF role). All five roles are independent; a single manifest MAY contain entries under any subset, including both RING and LID.

file_id.description: SMDR2 internal file identifier — lowercase hex, derived from the DXF content hash. Stable across re-exports of the same file. The first 8 hex characters are the canonical short form used elsewhere in SMDR2.

dxf.description: Bundle-relative path to the DXF file. POSIX path separator (`/`). MUST resolve to a regular file inside the bundle.

match_json.description: Bundle-relative path to the Match JSON for this DXF. Same path conventions as `dxf`. The JSON object has keys of the form `<class>.<index>` or `<view>.<class>.<index>` where `<view>` ∈ {`top_view`, `bottom_view`, `side_view`}, and values are lists of handle-list match instances.

user_unit.description: Unit currently in force for the operator: the operator's unit-picker override if set, otherwise the effective unit implied by the applied auto-rescale factor. `null` when no named unit applies (a unitless file the detector rescaled to a non-standard factor). Micrometre is spelled `um` (ASCII). In practice never `km` (the picker offers none).

original_unit.description: The DXF's declared `$INSUNITS` header mapped to a unit string (1=inch, 4=mm, 5=cm, 6=m, 7=km, 13=um). `null` when the header is unitless (0), an unsupported unit (e.g. 2=foot), or missing. Reports the header verbatim, independent of whether the rescaler acted on it.

view.description: The views this DXF carries, in canonical order top → bottom → side — one entry per side-region the operator has set on the file. `[]` when no side regions are set. Values are `top`/`bottom`/`side`, corresponding to the Match JSON key prefixes `top_view`/`bottom_view`/`side_view` (the `_view` suffix is dropped here).
